title: The growing amplification of social media: Measuring temporal and social contagion dynamics for over 150 languages on Twitter for 2009-2020
reasoning: The paper analyzes social contagion dynamics on Twitter by measuring retweet rates across languages. It does not have a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. Mentions of 'fake news' or 'malicious intents' are contextual and do not constitute a core part of the research methodology or evaluation.
